about:
Nelnet Renewable Energy is headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska. The company was acquired by MARS Energy Group, a national leader in commercial and utility-scale solar solutions, engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services, and long-term energy infrastructure. Its founding year and ownership details have not been publicly disclosed.

The firm provides EPC services for commercial, industrial, and utility-scale solar projects and manages a tax equity financing platform with over $313 million under management alongside co-investment partners. It also operates a venture capital investment team focused on CleanTech and ClimateTech innovation. While many commercial solar services are now delivered through MARS Energy Group, Nelnet continues to support a set of legacy offerings for existing customers.

Its customer base includes commercial and industrial solar developers, residential solar owners in Illinois, Missouri, and Wisconsin, and tax equity investors seeking renewable energy assets. Workmanship warranty support for projects in Colorado, Indiana, Iowa, and Nebraska has been transitioned to local partners such as Photon Brothers, Jefferson Electric, SolQ, and Nebraska Solar Providers.

Nelnet emphasizes that the acquisition brings nationwide reach, proven EPC expertise, advanced technical and financial capabilities, and a commitment to reliability and transparency, positioning the combined entity for long-term performance in the solar infrastructure market.
